item.title: Pentagon hosts first-ever Israeli–Lebanese military talks aimed at curbing Hezbollah
item.description: Israeli and Lebanese military delegations open U.S.-brokered talks at the Pentagon focused on ceasefire enforcement and border stability amid tensions.

item.title: Christian farming communities under siege as US report names Fulani militants Nigeria's deadliest threat
item.description: The USCIRF report states that Fulani militant violence in Nigeria surpasses that of Boko Haram and ISIS, with mostly Christians and also some Muslims being targeted in widespread attacks.

item.title: Hamas struggles to fill leadership ranks as Israel hunts Oct 7 terrorists
item.description: Hours after an Israeli airstrike killed Hamas military wing chief Mohammed Odeh, Gaza's Eid markets were full, revealing a disconnect with Hamas.

item.title: Drone strikes apartment building in NATO member Romania as Russia attacks neighboring Ukraine
item.description: A drone entered Romanian airspace and struck an apartment building, causing an explosion and fire that injured multiple people, authorities said.

item.title: Moscow, Taliban forge military alliance in power grab after US Afghanistan exit: reports
item.description: Russia and Afghanistan's Taliban government reportedly signed a military cooperation pact, solidifying Moscow's growing alliance in Central Asia.

item.title: Putin lands $16.5B nuclear win on Russia's doorstep in massive Kazakhstan pact: reports
item.description: Putin and Tokayev signed a landmark $16.5 billion nuclear power plant deal, marking Russia's geopolitical victory in Central Asia, reports say.

item.title: Israel accuses UN of placing it on same sexual violence blacklist as Hamas terrorists, severs ties
item.description: Israeli officials blast the U.N. after accusing the body of placing Israel on a sexual violence blacklist that also includes Hamas and other terrorist groups.

item.title: Three wounded in Swiss train station 'bladed weapon' attack, phrase 'Allahu Akbar' allegedly shouted
item.description: Police say a 31-year-old was arrested after allegedly wounding three people using a bladed weapon at train station in Switzerland.

item.title: US ally pledges support for Trump's push to break Iran's grip on Hormuz: 'We are ready to contribute'
item.description: Czech Foreign Minister Macinka voices strong support for Trump, defends increased European defense spending and warns Iran poses a global nuclear threat.

item.title: Crash involving speeding train, minibus in Belgium leaves 4 dead including 2 children
item.description: Four people, including two children, were killed when a passenger train hit a minibus at a crossing near Buggenhout, Belgium, during the morning rush.
